topology.scope: Single Windows processor group, physical-core affinity masks.

plan.scope: User-selected 96-game descriptive baseline: all three M1 candidate paths, two opponents, two equal-time controls, fixed first four source-bank families and paired colors. Reuse identical v6 runtime33; no Elo, promotion, 768-game completion or pooled partial scores.

accounting_policy.job_api: QueryInformationJobObject(JobObjectBasicAccountingInformation): delta(TotalUserTime + TotalKernelTime), active and terminated processes
accounting_policy.coordinator_api: GetProcessTimes: fixed coordinator PID and creation time; coordinator must not belong to the measured job
accounting_policy.pre_assignment_cpu_boundary_role: diagnostic only; do not assume additive offset or strict residual bounds
accounting_policy.full_process_attribution_role: additional diagnostic, not an inferred per-app split of residual
accounting_policy.threshold_scope: whole-host residual CPU fraction using the unchanged load_policy; not a total-busy or per-lane cap

engine_cpu_policy.preflight_gate: 24 complete legal games; frozen settings, complete per-search CPU/response records, no real failure, product and independent audits PASS
engine_cpu_policy.main_gate: 768 complete legal games under same record and audit requirements

main_selection_policy.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sort_keys=true, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false

git_receipts.scope: Actual root Git command at freeze; stdout uses existing harness strip normalization.
